title: SB2958 (113th General Assembly): AN ACT to amend Tennessee Code Annotated, Title 16; Title 18, Chapter 4; Title 33, Chapter 3; Title 38, Chapter 6; Title 39, Chapter 17, Part 13 and Title 68, Chapter 11, relative to the transfer of firearms.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Tennessee); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Tennessee text (Draft, 2024-02-14; official copy via the Internet Archive snapshot 20260514151406 of https://www.capitol.tn.gov/Bills/113/Bill/SB2958.pdf (LegiScan doc 2927757))
provenance.note: Draft as introduced (2024-02-14); no amendments in text read. Twin HB 1593 is on the same document. Short title in SECTION 1: "Keeping our Streets Safe: Expand Background Checks Act." The new section's number is not printed. Sections 3-10 (TCA 16-10-213, 16-11-206, 16-15-303, 16-16-120, 18-4-103, 18-4-203, 33-3-117, 68-11-210) shorten clerk reporting deadlines to 72 hours; treated as part of the background-check subject, not a separate topic. Only a sample of those instruction sentences is quoted.

operative_text:
SECTION 2 (new section, TCA Title 39, Chapter 17, Part 13): (b) A person shall not sell or transfer ownership of a firearm, or purchase or obtain ownership of a firearm, unless one (1) of the following applies:
SECTION 2 (new section, subsection (b)(1)): The seller or transferor is a gun dealer;
SECTION 2 (new section, subsection (b)(2)): The seller or transferor makes the sale or transfer to or through a gun dealer and obtains a receipt;
SECTION 2 (new section, subsection (c)): Any person who intentionally violates subsection (b) commits a Class B misdemeanor and shall be fined not less than five hundred dollars ($500) nor more than ten thousand dollars ($10,000) and may be imprisoned for a period not to exceed nine (9) months. A person convicted under this section is prohibited from possessing a firearm for a period of two (2) years.
SECTION 3 (TCA 16-10-213(b)): deleting "as soon as practicable, but no later than the third business day" and substituting "within seventy-two (72) hours".
SECTION 7 (TCA 18-4-103(9)): deleting "as soon as practicable but no later than thirty (30) days" and substituting "within seventy-two (72) hours".
SECTION 9 (TCA 33-3-117(a)): deleting "the third business day" wherever it appears and substituting "seventy-two (72) hours".
